fusions.name: Shoulder to Shoulder
fusions.desc: A horned shove that deals 4 damage and leaves the target 6% easier to wound for 6 seconds. Its damage rises 10% for each ally within 5.5 tiles, up to 40%.

fusions.name: Unhurried Stamp
fusions.desc: After 1.5 seconds of gathering, stamps down for 32 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and leaves them [Slowed] for 5 seconds. Against a boss or elite it also deals 5% of their maximum health.

fusions.name: Lagoon Pasture
fusions.desc: Raises a shallow reef where you stand. For 10 seconds it restores 3 health a second to you and any ally within 4 tiles of it. Every ally within 5.5 tiles makes it 10% stronger, up to 4.

fusions.name: Chewing It Over
fusions.desc: Every time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 8. At 8 they all spend at once: you are healed for 5% of your maximum health per stack (40% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
